name: cf-pages-hono-blog
description: A full-stack personal blog for Cloudflare Pages: Hono + D1 + R2, dark theme, site-wide password lock and admin editor.

scripts.dev: npm run build && wrangler pages dev ./public --d1 DB=blog-db --r2 BUCKET=blog-images --compatibility-date=2024-09-23 --compatibility-flags=nodejs_compat --live-reload
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy ./public --project-name=my-blog
